items.name: activity-pill
items.title: Activity Pill
items.description: A floating pill for the one thing the system is doing, which morphs from running to progress to done and expands for detail and actions.

useCases: Showing one long-running job, such as a deploy, an upload, or an export, from start to success or failure.
limitations: Shows one activity at a time; a new one replaces the last. It is not a queue or a notification stack, and it does not dismiss by swipe.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors including popover, primary, muted, and destructive. Render one pill near the root and drive it with useActivity or the activity prop. Reduced motion swaps size and content with a cross-fade.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/activity-pill.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: ascii-morph
items.title: ASCII Morph
items.description: A cloud of characters that morphs into a globe, a flower, and an a1 monogram.

useCases: Interactive ASCII illustrations for landing pages, portfolios, and identity studies.
limitations: Four built-in silhouettes only: globe, flower, a1, and the a1ui logo. Does not convert images or arbitrary text into ASCII.
requirements: React, Tailwind CSS, and Motion. Uses SVG, matchMedia, and IntersectionObserver. Reduced motion cross-fades between shapes in place. No automatic animation or pause control is needed.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/ascii-morph.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: ascii-lens
items.title: ASCII Lens
items.description: An image rendered as ASCII, with a circular lens that reveals the original.

useCases: Portfolio and product cards that reveal source artwork through an interactive lens.
limitations: Remote images must allow canvas pixel reads through CORS; otherwise ASCII sampling falls back to the original image.
requirements: Supply an image URL and alt text. Requires Canvas 2D, ResizeObserver, and IntersectionObserver. Remote images need anonymous CORS permission for ASCII sampling.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/ascii-lens.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: ascii-terrain
items.title: ASCII Terrain
items.description: A landscape made of characters, with rolling hills, pointer sculpting, and click ripples.

useCases: Interactive ASCII landscapes and decorative hero backgrounds.
limitations: Procedural illustration only. No geographic data or persistent terrain editing. JavaScript is required to draw.
requirements: Supply a pause control for automatic motion. Requires Canvas 2D, ResizeObserver, and IntersectionObserver. Reduced motion shows a static landscape.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/ascii-terrain.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: text-banner
items.title: Text Banner
items.description: Bold text and staggered pixel separators in a seamless, infinitely scrolling banner.

useCases: Continuously scrolling words or phrases with separators for page banners.
limitations: Plain text only. Repeated content is decorative and cannot contain links or controls.
requirements: Supply items and a pause control using the paused prop. Requires ResizeObserver. Reduced motion displays one static sequence.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/text-banner.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: shape-flow
items.title: Shape Flow
items.description: Text that reflows around a floating ASCII duck, powered by Pretext.

useCases: Editorial text wrapping around a floating ASCII duck.
limitations: One left-to-right plain-text paragraph. Rich text and right-to-left flow are unsupported.
requirements: Use a loaded named font. Interactive layout needs Canvas 2D, Intl.Segmenter, and ResizeObserver.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/shape-flow.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: text-scramble
items.title: Text Scramble
items.description: Reveals new text from left to right through a scramble of random characters.

useCases: Animating changing headings, labels, or status text through scrambled characters.
limitations: The initial text does not animate. Animation starts when the text prop changes.
requirements: Update the text prop to animate. Use a monospace font to reduce width shifts.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/text-scramble.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: section-rail
items.title: Section Rail
items.description: A compact reading rail that tracks progress through page sections.

useCases: Table of contents and reading progress for long pages with sections.
limitations: Tracks existing DOM sections; it does not create the page content.
requirements: Match every item ID to a section element on the page.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/section-rail.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: spiral-text
items.title: Spiral Text
items.description: Text set on a responsive spiral that tightens under pressure and ripples on release.

useCases: Decorative spiral typography with pointer interaction.
limitations: A decorative text composition, not a reading paragraph or changing-label effect.
requirements: Supply text and room for the responsive spiral.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/spiral-text.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: particle-menu
items.title: Particle Menu
items.description: Grainy symbols that scatter around your pointer and spring back into place.

useCases: Artistic navigation with interactive particle symbols.
limitations: A specialized visual navigation treatment, not a general dropdown selector.
requirements: Supply labeled items with supported shapes and navigation destinations.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/particle-menu.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: A ⌘K command palette that materialises from its trigger, with fuzzy search, a gliding highlight, and nested pages.

useCases: A keyboard-first launcher for navigation and actions, opened from a button or with ⌘K or Ctrl+K.
limitations: Filters the items it is given in memory; it does not fetch results. Shortcut hints on items are labels and are not bound. One palette should own the ⌘K shortcut per page.
requirements: React 19.2, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give every item a stable id that is unique among its siblings. Reduced motion replaces the scale, blur, and row travel with short fades.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/command-palette.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: arc-reel
items.title: Arc Reel
items.description: An infinitely looping reel with curved provider cards and synchronized scroll controls.

useCases: Looping galleries, provider cards, or logo reels with drag and keyboard controls.
limitations: Supply your own artwork; demo images are not installed.
requirements: Theme tokens --background, --foreground, --border, and --muted-foreground must exist.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/arc-reel.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: task-steps
items.title: Task Steps
items.description: An ordered list that narrates a long-running job, with status icons that morph in place, a live timer on each step, and logs that open while a step runs.

useCases: Builds, deployments, imports, and agent runs where several named steps start, finish, fail, or are skipped over time.
limitations: Display only: the caller owns each step's status. Measured times start when the block first sees a step running, so pass startedAt and durationMs for a job that began before the block mounted. Log lines are plain strings.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors including --destructive. Give every step a stable id. Reduced motion cross-fades the icons, stops the spinner, and changes panel heights at once.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/task-steps.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: A copy button that animates its icon and label into a checkmark and copied confirmation.

useCases: Copying text, links, and code with animated success feedback.
limitations: Copies plain text only. Clipboard access requires HTTPS or localhost and browser permission.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and Phosphor icons. Supply value. Reduced motion skips the transitions.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/copy-button.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: loading-button
items.title: Loading Button
items.description: A loading button with animated icon and label transitions for async actions and network requests.

useCases: Submitting data, saving changes, and running network requests with loading, success, and retry feedback.
limitations: Runs the supplied action on click. Does not submit forms automatically or cancel requests. Success resets after two seconds.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and Phosphor icons. Supply onClick and return its promise. Throw or reject on failure, including non-OK fetch responses. Reduced motion skips transitions and spinner rotation.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/loading-button.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: confirm-button
items.title: Confirm Button
items.description: A hold-to-confirm button with a directional color fill and configurable hold duration.

useCases: Deliberate confirmation actions that require an uninterrupted pointer or keyboard hold.
limitations: onConfirm fires once per completed hold. The caller handles asynchronous work and errors. Confirmation stays visible for two seconds after release before resetting. Click-only activation does not confirm.
requirements: React 19.2 or later, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, Phosphor icons, and the shared UI Button. Supply onConfirm in a client component. duration is in seconds; direction is right, left, up, or down.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/confirm-button.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A shared highlight that travels between focused and selected menu items.

useCases: Sidebar navigation and view selectors with a traveling focus and selection highlight.
limitations: Selection is controlled by the caller. Each item needs a unique value. Keep item overflow visible so the highlight can travel between rows.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and Base UI. Supply value and wrap each link or button with MenuItem. Reduced motion switches the highlight instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/menu.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A shadcn dropdown with open and close transitions and a traveling highlight.

useCases: Action menus with animated open and close transitions and a shared pointer and keyboard highlight.
limitations: Uses the shadcn Base UI variant. Animated highlights cover regular action items and submenu triggers; checkbox items and radio items use the underlying shadcn components.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, Base UI, and the shadcn Dropdown Menu. Reduced motion removes popup and highlight transitions.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/dropdown-menu.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click menu that grows out of the pointer, with checkbox and radio items, submenus, and a traveling highlight.

useCases: Actions for the thing under the pointer: files, rows, canvas objects, and editor selections.
limitations: A keyboard open hangs below the focused element instead of the pointer. The long press is touch only and takes half a second. Labels must sit inside a group.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, Base UI, and theme colors. Give the trigger tabIndex={0} when nothing inside it can take focus. Reduced motion fades without scaling.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/context-menu.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: icon-toggle
items.title: Icon Toggle
items.description: A two-state icon button that morphs its SVG paths on every click.

useCases: Icon toggles with a reversible morph between two states, such as menu and close or play and pause.
limitations: Custom path pairs must use matching SVG commands and coordinate counts in a 24 by 24 viewBox. Uses rounded strokes with no fill. Does not morph arbitrary React icon components.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and the shared UI Button. Supply a stable accessible label. Controlled usage requires updating pressed in onPressedChange. Reduced motion switches paths instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/icon-toggle.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A slider with magnetic stops that catch the thumb and pulse as you slide through them.

useCases: Adjusting values with magnetic catches at meaningful presets or unevenly spaced stops.
limitations: Horizontal single-thumb slider. Feedback is visual and does not vibrate the device. Dense stop labels can overlap.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Supply label and stops. Keyboard input bypasses magnetic snapping. Reduced motion removes animation and preserves snapping.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/slider.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: wheel-picker
items.title: Wheel Picker
items.description: A drum-style picker that scrolls natively and selects the option at its centre, with wheels that sit side by side for times and dates.

useCases: Choosing one value from a short or long ordered list, such as a time, a date, a duration or a quantity, with several wheels side by side.
limitations: Single selection of string values in a vertical wheel with fixed-height rows; it does not loop. Haptic ticks need the Vibration API, which iOS Safari does not provide. The fade masks suit a plain surface behind the wheel.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, and theme colors. No animation library. Supply label and options with unique values. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion flattens the drum and positions the wheel instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/wheel-picker.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time code field with 4, 6, or 8 slots, a traveling focus highlight, and characters that rise into place.

useCases: Entering numeric or alphanumeric verification, two-factor, and invite codes of 4, 6, or 8 characters.
limitations: Single row of 4, 6, or 8 slots. Edits happen at the end of the code; clicking a filled slot does not move the caret into it. Alphanumeric codes are uppercased.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Supply a label. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion removes animation and keeps a static caret.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/otp-input.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: validated-input
items.title: Validated Input
items.description: A labeled text field that checks its value against a Zod schema and animates the error and success states.

useCases: Validating emails, usernames, URLs, and other single-line text fields with Zod in native forms.
limitations: Validates one field against a synchronous schema that accepts a string. Shows the first issue only. Cross-field and async checks belong to the caller.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Phosphor icons, Zod 4, and the shadcn input and label components. Supply label and schema. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion removes the shake and transitions.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/validated-input.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: A text field that collects multiple tags, with a two-step Backspace removal and an optional limit.

useCases: Collecting keywords, topics, skills, labels, or email recipients as a list of short tags in forms.
limitations: Tags are plain trimmed strings added at the end; duplicates are rejected case-insensitively. No suggestions, reordering, or inline editing of existing tags.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Phosphor icons, the shadcn label component, and theme colors. Supply a label. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion removes the shake and transitions.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/tag-input.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field that requires a strong password, with a strength meter that opens its requirements on hover, and a show/hide toggle.

useCases: Requiring a strong password in sign-up, password reset, and change-password forms, with a compact meter that reveals each requirement on hover.
limitations: Strength comes only from synchronous rules; there is no entropy estimate, breached-password lookup, or confirmation field. Every rule must pass for the field to be valid.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, Phosphor icons, and the shadcn input and label components. Supply a label. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion removes the shake and transitions.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/password-input.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with a spring indicator that slides between triggers, a hover highlight, and direction-aware panels.

useCases: Switching between related views, such as dashboard sections or settings panes, where the active tab should feel connected to the last one.
limitations: Horizontal orientation only. Panels unmount when inactive. The underline variant expects one row of triggers.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give each TabsTrigger and TabsContent a matching string value and the list an aria-label. Reduced motion moves the indicator and swaps panels instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/tabs.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A switch whose thumb squashes on press, springs across the track, and can rotate icons in and out.

useCases: Settings that apply immediately, such as notifications or dark mode, with optional icons for the two states.
limitations: One size, 44 by 24 pixels. Thumb icons should be small glyphs about 12 pixels across.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Supply label or aria-label. Controlled usage requires updating checked in onCheckedChange. Reduced motion removes the squash and moves the thumb instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/switch.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox that draws its check, morphs from an indeterminate dash, and can strike through its label.

useCases: Task lists, consent fields, and select-all groups where a parent shows a partial selection.
limitations: The strikethrough is a single 1px line drawn with a background gradient. Indeterminate state is controlled by the caller.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Supply label or aria-label. Clear indeterminate in onCheckedChange. Reduced motion draws the mark instantly and removes the burst.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/checkbox.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A radio group whose single dot slides from option to option, with a card variant whose highlighted border glides between cards.

useCases: Plan pickers, settings with a few mutually exclusive choices, and shipping or payment options shown as cards.
limitations: Values are strings. The card highlight scales between cards of different heights, so its border can stretch slightly mid-flight.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give the group aria-label or aria-labelledby, and each item a label or aria-label. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion moves the dot and highlight instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/radio-group.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: chip-group
items.title: Chip Group
items.description: Chips that press on their own, popping in with a drawn check.

useCases: Picking several filters, tags, or formatting options as chips.
limitations: Multiple selection only; use SegmentedControl for a single choice. Chips wrap onto new lines. Icon-only detection treats any item without text children as icon-only.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give each ChipGroupItem a unique string value, the group an aria-label, and icon-only items an aria-label. Reduced motion presses chips instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/chip-group.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: An accordion whose panels glide open to their natural height, stagger their content in, and turn a chevron or fold a plus into a minus.

useCases: FAQs, settings sections, and long forms where readers open one or several sections at a time.
limitations: Only direct child elements of AccordionContent stagger in; plain text fades as one block. Closed panels unmount, so browser find-in-page does not search them.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give every AccordionItem a unique value. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion opens panels instantly and skips the stagger.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/accordion.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: Twelve looping indicators for waits of unknown length, from a leaning ring to sliding tiles, all sized and timed from two props.

useCases: Searches, saves, page sections, and background jobs where the wait has no known length or percentage.
limitations: Indeterminate only: it cannot show a value or a percentage. The infinity dash and the morph outline animate on the main thread, so they can stutter while the page is busy; the other variants animate transform and opacity only. Stack lines travel slightly outside the box as they fade. The line variant fills its container and needs a width.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and a text color to inherit. Pick a variant, size, and cycle. The root has role status and announces label, or aria-label when there is no visible label. Reduced motion holds the shape still and breathes its opacity; a cycle of zero holds a still frame.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/loader.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog that springs in at the center of the screen over a blurred backdrop, and rises from the bottom edge on small screens.

useCases: Focused tasks that interrupt the page, such as editing a profile, sharing a link, or confirming settings.
limitations: Modal only. One popup per Dialog. Below 640px it rises from the bottom edge instead of scaling in at the center. Use an alert dialog for destructive confirmations that must not close on an outside click.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give every DialogContent a DialogTitle. Reduced motion replaces the scale and slide with a short fade.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/dialog.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A draggable sheet with detents that tracks the pointer, throws to the nearest stop, and rubber-bands at its limit, from the bottom, left, or right edge.

useCases: Mobile detail views, filters, pickers, and side panels that people drag between sizes or throw away, where the sheet should follow the pointer and keep the page behind in view.
limitations: Modal only. One popup per Sheet. Detents are fractions of the viewport, not pixel sizes. A scroll that has already started inside the sheet does not turn into a drag; lift and drag again from the top of the content. Wheel and trackpad scrolling never move the sheet. Push back scales one element you nominate, and fixed elements inside it move with it.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give every SheetContent a SheetTitle and put scrolling content in SheetBody. Reduced motion fades the sheet instead of sliding it and turns off push back. Reduced transparency and increased contrast make the surface solid.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/sheet.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A confirmation dialog that springs in, shakes when you click outside it, and fades out before it unmounts.

useCases: Confirming destructive or irreversible actions such as deleting a project, signing out, or discarding unsaved changes.
limitations: One centered size capped at 28rem wide. Backdrop clicks never close it. Cancel and Action always close the dialog, so run async work before or after rather than inside the dialog.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors including destructive. Always include AlertDialogTitle and AlertDialogDescription. Controlled usage requires updating open in onOpenChange. Reduced motion opens and closes instantly and removes the shake.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/alert-dialog.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toasts that stack as a deck, fan out on hover, and swipe away, with a loading state that morphs into success.

useCases: Save confirmations, errors, undo actions, and long-running uploads or deploys that resolve to success or failure.
limitations: Three toasts show in the collapsed deck. Swiping is horizontal only. Success and default share the foreground color; errors use the destructive color.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors including destructive. Wrap the app in ToastProvider and render one Toaster inside it. Reduced motion places toasts instantly and stops the spinner.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/toast.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A tooltip that springs from its trigger and glides between neighboring triggers, morphing its size and text.

useCases: Icon-button toolbars, editor controls, and dense action bars where hints should follow the pointer from button to button.
limitations: Tooltips inside one gliding TooltipProvider share a single popup, so only one shows at a time. Tooltip text is a hint for pointer and keyboard users; it is not announced on touch devices, so icon buttons still need an aria-label.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Wrap triggers in TooltipProvider to share delays and glide between them. Reduced motion shows and moves the tooltip instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/tooltip.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A link preview card that springs out from its trigger and staggers its contents in.

useCases: Profile mentions, linked repositories, and glossary terms that preview more detail without leaving the page.
limitations: Only direct children of HoverCardContent stagger; wrap pieces that should arrive together. Touch devices never open the card, so the trigger must work as a plain link and the card must not hold the only copy of important content.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. The trigger renders a link, so give it an href or a render element. Opens after openDelay on mouse hover or keyboard focus and closes on Escape or an outside press. Reduced motion shows and hides the card instantly without the stagger.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/hover-card.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A popover that springs out of its trigger, or morphs the trigger button itself into the panel.

useCases: Small anchored panels such as display settings, filters, or share options, and a feedback button that opens into a short form in place.
limitations: Morph panels open over the trigger instead of beside it, wrap the popover in an inline-flex box, support only top and bottom sides, and never flip or shift to stay in the viewport. The morph trigger is a 36 pixel pill.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give the panel a PopoverTitle or aria-label. Controlled usage requires updating open in onOpenChange. Reduced motion opens and closes the panel instantly without the morph.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/popover.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A select whose list springs open from the trigger, with a traveling highlight, a drawn check, and a cross-fading value.

useCases: Picking one option from a short or grouped list, such as a region, plan, or sort order, where a native select feels out of place.
limitations: Single selection of string values only. The trigger shows labels from the items prop; without it the raw value is shown. Aligning the selected item over the trigger applies to mouse input and falls back to opening below near viewport edges.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Pass items so the trigger can label the value, and give SelectTrigger an aria-label or aria-labelledby. Reduced motion opens, closes, and moves the highlight instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/select.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: Overlapping avatars that spring apart on hover, lift with a name label, and fan extra people out of a counting +N chip.

useCases: Showing who is on a project, in a document, or in a call, with names on hover and focus and a +N chip for the rest.
limitations: Initials or local images only; there is no remote image loading policy. Sizes are sm, md, and lg (32, 40, and 48 pixels). The fanned-out row sits below the group in a single line, so very long overflow lists should use a smaller max or a separate list.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Pass Avatar elements with a name as children, and give the group an aria-label. Controlled usage requires updating open in onOpenChange. Reduced motion keeps the spread and labels but makes every change instant and shows the count without counting.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/avatar-group.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: An image viewer whose thumbnail grows to fill the screen and returns to the same thumbnail, with swipe paging, pinch zoom, and drag to dismiss.

useCases: Opening photos, screenshots, or product shots from a grid or an article into a full-screen view that people can swipe through, zoom, and flick away.
limitations: Images only, no video or embeds. Renders the current image and its two neighbours, so very long galleries page one image at a time. Thumbnails are assumed to crop with object-fit cover around their centre. Arrow keys follow left-to-right order.
requirements: React 19.2, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give every image alt text, and width and height when you know them. Controlled usage requires updating open and index in their change handlers. Reduced motion cross-fades in place instead of travelling, paging, or springing.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/lightbox.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A badge whose count rolls like an odometer, resizes smoothly, pops in from zero, and can pulse a live status dot.

useCases: Unread and notification counts on icons or tabs, status labels with a live indicator, and small tags such as Beta or New.
limitations: One size, 20 pixels tall. Counts are whole numbers of zero or more, and the badge hides at zero unless showZero is set. The status dot uses the text color of the variant.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Pass countLabel so screen readers hear what a count means; counts are announced through a polite live region. The count is a Rolling Number, installed alongside. Reduced motion cross-fades the digits, skips the pop, and stops the pulse.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/badge.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: rolling-number
items.title: Rolling Number
items.description: A number that rolls digit by digit to each new value, up for an increase and down for a decrease, with Intl formatting and an optional delta chip.

useCases: Live metrics, prices, balances, scores, and counters where a changing value should show which way it moved without shifting the layout.
limitations: Display only: the caller owns the value. The visible digits cannot be selected; copying across the number copies the formatted text. The delta chip is positioned outside the number's box and does not reserve space. Slots are laid out left to right in the order Intl.NumberFormat returns them.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Pass locale explicitly when rendering on a server so the server and browser format alike. Set announce only for values that change rarely. Reduced motion cross-fades the digits that changed.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/rolling-number.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page numbers with an active surface that slides between pages, a window that reflows as it moves, and ellipses that fade in and out.

useCases: Paging through search results, tables, feeds, and archives, either in client state or as links to real routes such as /posts?page=3.
limitations: Pages are numbered from 1 and the component does not fetch or slice data; the caller owns the page count and the content. There is no page-size picker or jump-to-page input, and the ellipses are not clickable.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Pass pageCount, and either page with onPageChange or defaultPage. For routes, pass getHref, renderLink, or both; renderLink receives anchor props and the target page. Reduced motion moves the active surface and the number window instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/pagination.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keycap that sinks and springs back when its key is pressed, with platform-aware labels and combos that pulse when held.

useCases: Keyboard shortcut hints in menus, tooltips, command palettes, and onboarding, where the keycap presses as the user tries the shortcut.
limitations: One size, 24 pixels tall. Listening shows the press only; it never prevents the browser default or runs an action, so pair it with your own shortcut handler. Labels cover Mac and a single label set for every other platform.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Use mod for the platform command key: ⌘ on Mac, Ctrl elsewhere. Labels render as Ctrl on the server and switch after mount, so pass platform to pin them. Reduced motion keeps the press state but moves the cap instantly and shows the combo pulse as a still glow.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/kbd.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholders that shimmer in sync, then swap to the real content on a soft spring, with no flash on fast loads and no layout jump.

useCases: Cards, lists, and profile headers that wait on data, where the placeholder should match the final layout and hand over to the content without a jump.
limitations: The shimmer runs on the Web Animations API and is lined up by page position, measured when placeholders mount or resize; a placeholder that moves without resizing keeps its old alignment. A wrapper without a fallback covers its children with one block, so the children need a size while loading.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Wrap content in Skeleton with loading, and pass fallback for a custom placeholder layout. The wrapper sets aria-busy and announces loadingLabel. The placeholder waits out delay before it appears and then stays for at least minVisible; a server-rendered placeholder shows at once. Reduced motion removes the shimmer and pulse and swaps to the content instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/skeleton.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A breadcrumb trail whose middle collapses into an expandable ellipsis, with segments that slide in and out as you navigate.

useCases: Showing where a page sits in a deep hierarchy, such as a file browser, docs tree, or nested settings, where the trail changes as people move around.
limitations: Data-driven only: pass the whole trail as items. Collapsing hides a single run of middle segments. Fitting measures the nav's own width (full width by default), so keep it out of shrink-to-fit containers or turn collapseToFit off there. The last item is always the current page.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Give each item a label and an href (except the current page); pass renderLink to use a router link such as Next.js Link. Reduced motion swaps segments instantly.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/breadcrumb.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: swipe-row
items.title: Swipe Row
items.description: A list row that swipes either way to reveal actions, with a full swipe that commits the primary one.

useCases: Quick actions on rows of a touch-first list, such as an inbox, a task list, or a queue: delete, pin, archive, or mark as read without opening the row.
limitations: Horizontal swipes only, and leading always means the left edge, so it does not mirror in right-to-left layouts. Every action is 72 pixels wide. The haptic tick uses navigator.vibrate, which Safari does not support. The row does not collapse its own height after a removing action; the list around it does that.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Give each action a label and an onAction, and put the primary action first. Set removesRow on an action that deletes the row and unmount the row in onAction. Wrap rows in SwipeRowGroup to keep one open at a time. Controlled usage requires updating open in onOpenChange. Reduced motion fades the actions in over the row instead of sliding it.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/swipe-row.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A single-choice control whose thumb you can drag or throw between options, with labels that invert as it passes through them.

useCases: Switching between two to five views, modes, or ranges where one is always shown, such as list and board, or day, week and month.
limitations: Horizontal and single-choice. Every segment is as wide as the widest label, so long or many labels make a wide control. Labels are drawn twice, once in each colour, so keep them to text and icons. The value is chosen on release, not while dragging.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, and theme colors. Pass options with unique string values, give the control an aria-label or aria-labelledby, and give icon-only options an aria-label. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion cross-fades the thumb between options instead of sliding it.

items.docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/segmented-control.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
